pages.text: The $(l)Sentinel Tower$() is a heavy defense evolution. It trades speed for $(b)devastating heavy ordinance$() and superior targeting.

pages.title: Homing Ordnance
pages.text: Fires $(b)Homing Missiles$() that deal $(4)6 Explosive Damage$(). $(br2)$(a)Note:$() Explosions $(b)will not$() damage your allies and you.
